summary: GI round 4, package PV1: E/M reading fixes (C1, C2) and the C4 holds, plus V3's hold-only nouns. Edits only cues.EM_TIME_ACTIVITIES, NOT_IN_PERSON, NOT_IN_PERSON_TITLE (new) and MDM_LEVEL (a third prefix sharing the 'level' group; read only by detect); detect._em_base_reading, _clause_reading_cues and _cue_reading (an 'activities' parameter, default None = installed), _not_in_person, EM_NOT_IN_PERSON, EM_ANOTHER_TIME and new _pv1_* helpers; checks._VAL_SERVICE_NOUNS. Nothing context.py or sections.py reads changes, so the request side cannot move: no cue the freeze inventories is added or changed, and the date channel, every request's bytes, every layout and both mention counts are unchanged. Every movement is in routing's gi.office_em reading and the E/M codes that follow it. Declared before any code was written; the base is installed 80df1831d168 (stage A's head 1e0733feb equals it on every pin).

rules.C1: an E/M time statement followed directly by 'covering', 'including', 'spent on' (or the prototype's synonyms) lists the visit's own work: clause cues and dates at or after that word never re-time the statement; cues before it still do; em-time mentions only
rules.C2: an inline 'complexity of decision making: X' / 'level of decision making: X' (':' or '-' after the label) gives MDM level X; 'shared decision making' never gives a level; the existing 'medical decision making' / 'MDM' readings are unchanged
rules.C4: a performed E/M reading of any kind (visit statement, heading, time, MDM) is held (uncertain, doubt) when the note says the patient was not seen in person, has no in-person contact, was seen by telephone or phone call (telephone/phone encounter, call, visit, follow-up, note; by/via/over the telephone or phone; telephonic; audio-only), was a no-show or did not arrive/attend/show up: anywhere outside plan and history sections, in a head title line whatever its section, or in the E/M statement's own sentence. Video, telehealth and virtual visits are NOT held. A reading installed already holds or reads not-performed is returned unchanged (no exclusion becomes a hold through C4)
rules.C4-time: installed's _another_time now also holds a performed E/M time statement ('Total time at her last visit was 40 minutes.')
rules.V3: _VAL_SERVICE_NOUNS gains imaging and laboratory nouns (ultrasound, sonogram, sonography, elastography, CT, MRI, MRCP, x-ray, scan, blood work, panel); it only turns an E/M code's own negative reading about another service into a hold

battery_note: Every other row is expected unchanged in bucket and status: E2, E3 and E4 have no E/M mention on installed (their framed time is PV2's), 'future visit time' and 'return visit + ultrasound (V3)' are already held for the same reasons, and no non-E/M row carries C1, C2 or C4 wording. The two movements remove two of installed's five known violations (both C4 E/M READYs); no new violation.

corrections.C1: NARROWED AGAIN: after the activity word only a planned cue that names the visit's own planning work is skipped - the cues 'ordered' ('the orders'), 'referred for' ('the referral to'), 'scheduled', 'booked' ('arranging'), 'recommend', 'consider', 'will', 'plan', 'to be done', 'should undergo', 'upcoming' ('awaiting'), and 'next' only as 'next step(s)'. A planned time ('in 2 weeks', 'next week/month/year/visit/appointment', 'tomorrow', 'due for/in/now/at') and every cue of another status (cancelled, postponed, deferred, not done, no-show; historical 'ago', 'last week', 'in the past', 'records reviewed', 'elsewhere'; incomplete; uncertain) governs the time statement as installed. Counterexamples, each held on installed and READY on a39f982a0, held again after this change: 'Total time: 15 minutes, spent on chart review, as the visit was cancelled.' (99212); 'Total time: 15 minutes, spent on her visit, which was cancelled.' (99212); 'Total time: 20 minutes, including the visit that was postponed.' (99212); 'Total time: 20 minutes, covering a visit that was not done.' (99212); 'Total time: 60 minutes, including 30 minutes of care coordination two days ago.' (99215); 'Total time: 30 minutes, including time spent in the past on her care.' (99214); 'Total time: 30 minutes, including the follow-up visit in 2 weeks.' (99214). Expected movement: none of the declared movements changes (h4-01's list and the generated activity lists carry only 'the orders' as a cue; no battery row has an activity list). Known cost, accepted: an activity list naming reviewed work by a historical cue ('outside records reviewed') stays held as installed.
corrections.C4: HOLD-ONLY SYNONYMS inside the declared categories: 'the patient / pt / she / he was (is) not seen' (not seen); a visit-type field naming the telephone ('Visit type: Telephone', 'Encounter type: phone', 'Type of visit: telephone'); 'missed her / his / their / the / this / today's appointment or visit' and 'left without being seen' / 'LWBS' (no-show). The probed forms read READY on installed and on a39f982a0 in a note that otherwise documents an office visit, and are held after this change. Expected: no regression document, battery row or declared movement changes (none carries these words); a corpus movement, if any, is a hold and is listed when measured; no MUST cell that passes on installed fails.
